svg.title: A what-if recalibration on a branch, compared with main
svg.desc: An agent refits theta without today's seven anomalous accounts, on a branch, compares the branch with main and deletes it. On the right, main (left cloud) keeps its theta and its seven anomalies throughout; the branch (right cloud) gets a tighter theta and six more accounts cross it, including account 42. Each cloud is scaled to its own theta: distance from the centroid is real (sqrt of delta_norm / theta_norm); angles are illustrative and the same account sits at the same angle in both clouds.
svg.text: Main never moved: the what-if lived on a branch.
